primary_user: An applicant and community adviser reconciling corrected documents before handing over a draft application packet.
painful_workflow: A helper replaces a document or corrects an extracted fact, but the preparation record does not distinguish the original assertion, its replacement, who confirmed it, and which conclusions still depend on the old version.
current_workaround: Hypothesized workaround: annotate document filenames and explain corrections in messages. The supplied evidence does not validate this behavior or demand for collaborative handoffs.
imported_mechanism: Parent: concept-006. Apply mechanism_07 to an append-only provenance ledger with explicit supersession and dependency invalidation. Structural changes include collaborative users, a document-reconciliation workflow, assertion-level data, and a provenance-record update as the terminal action.
data_sources: Generated fictional applicant, helper, document versions and assertion conflicts.
Generated rules for one explicitly fictional benefits program.
Supplied opp-006 evidence and repository description, used only as workflow inspiration.
core_computation: Store source documents, extracted assertions, confirmations and illustrative assessments as versioned nodes. A proposed correction identifies the superseded assertion and its supporting source. Require explicit applicant confirmation before atomically appending the replacement, attribution and supersession edge; invalidate the dependent closure and recompute in topological order. Reject cycles and stale-version writes. Preserve conflicting assertions as unresolved rather than silently choosing one. Digests establish content identity only. Bound scope to an explicitly authored, inspectable graph. No automatic OCR or arbitrary dependency discovery. No authoritative benefits eligibility, causal inference, clinical, authenticated-identity or validated-impact claims. If dependency coverage is unknown, mark dependent draft answers unresolved and block ready-to-export status until reviewed.
last_mile_action: Update the local provenance record with the confirmed replacement, source version, actor, confirmation event and affected assessment IDs; export a handoff receipt showing unresolved conflicts.
visible_transformation: Two conflicting document-derived assertions become an auditable supersession chain, with withdrawn conclusions and a durable receipt explaining who confirmed the correction and why.
sponsor_dependency: Uses the supplied brief's simulation alternative. No gated Alexa+ toolkit, hardware, AWS credentials or paid model is assumed; AI coding tools support implementation of the bounded conversational agent.
technical_risk: Incomplete assertion dependencies could leave stale conclusions valid; ambiguous speaker attribution could misrepresent confirmation. Keep two explicit simulated roles, a small acyclic graph, transactional writes and a visible confirmation step.
why_now: An October 22, 2026 repository description explicitly frames returning to a routine without starting over as a current objective.
killer_demo: In the custom Alexa+-style client, say or type: "That is my old payslip. Use the September document instead." For an ambiguous reference, ask the user which document. Show the exact replacement and affected draft answers, then ask confirmation. Commit it once, show affected answers withdrawn, retain unrelated ID evidence, export an updated packet, reload, and reject an outdated helper proposal. Use original synthetic documents. Label simulated roles and any bounded intent handling accurately.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The append-only event history, transactional version check and independently recomputed dependency closure let judges verify the actual record mutation and detect silently overwritten history.
mutation_history: round 1: empty action region: update a provenance record

No real Alexa+ device or preview-console connection is claimed.

testable_claim: For the bundled fixture, a confirmed correction appends exactly one attributed replacement record, preserves the prior assertion, invalidates exactly its dependent closure and rejects updates against a superseded version.
demo_proof: Show the before-and-after persisted ledger, supersession edge, actor confirmation and affected node IDs. A fixture oracle checks append-only history, stale-version rejection, exact dependent invalidation and survival across reload.
minimum_demonstrable_loop: One synthetic case with three original documents, two dependent draft answers and a preparation checklist. Inspect the source of an answer; propose a document correction; ask clarification for an ambiguous reference; confirm the exact proposal and case revision; atomically supersede the source, invalidate dependent answers while retaining unrelated facts, and export the corrected handoff receipt. Reload to prove persistence and reject an edit prepared against the previous revision. Unknown dependencies remain unresolved. Reserve testing, public video, product feedback and submission time inside the delivery plan.
